initial_menu.hinglish:
Hello ji! Hum businesses ko grow karne ke liye 2 focused services provide karte hain:

1. Web Development (Professional business website, 100% mobile responsive, fast loading, WhatsApp/contact integration)
2. Performance Marketing (Google aur Meta ads campaign setup, targeted audience reach aur regular leads)

Aapko inme se kis cheez me zyada interest hai — Website ya Performance Marketing?
initial_menu.english:
Hello! We help businesses grow through 2 core services:

1. Web Development (Professional business website, mobile responsive design, fast loading, WhatsApp/contact integration)
2. Performance Marketing (Google & Meta ads campaign setup, targeted audience reach, quality lead generation)

Which of these are you more interested in — Website or Performance Marketing?

services.name: Web Development
services.tagline: Professional business website that builds trust and drives customer inquiries
services.description: Custom, modern, and mobile-friendly websites designed for doctors, local businesses, professionals, and service providers.
features: Mobile responsive design (looks great on phones, tablets & desktops)
Basic SEO setup for Google search presence
Direct Contact and WhatsApp chat integration
Basic business information and service/about pages
Fast loading speed & modern clean layout

simple.label: Simple Website
simple.criteria: 1-3 pages, essential business info, contact/WhatsApp button, clean mobile layout

medium.label: Medium Website
medium.criteria: 4-6 pages, dedicated service sections, contact form, custom branding, SEO basics

advanced.label: Advanced Website
advanced.criteria: Multi-page dynamic structure, custom inquiry workflow, premium UI/UX, advanced SEO and analytics

qualification_questions: Aapka business kis type ka hai (clinic, shop, consultancy ya local service)?
Kya aapke paas pehle se koi website bani hui hai ya bilkul nayi banwani hai?
Aapko website me roughly kitne pages ya specific sections chahiye honge?

already_have_website.angle: Redesign, Speed & Conversion OR Performance Marketing
already_have_website.guidance: Do not force a new website. Politely check if their current site is mobile-friendly and fast, OR offer Performance Marketing to drive targeted traffic to their existing site!

price_too_high.angle: Highlight inclusions and offer starter package
price_too_high.guidance: Explain what is included (mobile UI, WhatsApp button, hosting setup) and offer a clean starter package within ₹5,000 without compromising quality.

not_needed_now.guidance: Respect their timeline warmly, let them know we are available whenever they plan to expand digital presence.

send_details.guidance: Share a 3-bullet customized overview specific to their business type instead of dumping a generic brochure.

services.name: Performance Marketing
services.tagline: Data-driven Google & Meta ad campaigns that generate genuine customer inquiries
services.description: Targeted paid advertising on Meta (Facebook/Instagram) and Google Ads designed to bring quality leads and phone calls for your business.
features: Complete campaign setup & ad account structure
suitable_for: Local service businesses looking for daily calls/leads
Clinics and healthcare specialists needing patient appointments
Real estate and high-ticket service consultants
Businesses with an existing website wanting direct traffic

simple.label: Basic Campaign Setup & Management
simple.criteria: Single platform (Meta or Google), basic audience targeting, 1-2 ad sets, weekly reporting

medium.label: Medium Performance Campaign
medium.criteria: Dual platform setup, retargeting audience, A/B creative testing, bi-weekly optimization

advanced.label: Higher Requirement Performance Campaign
advanced.criteria: Multi-campaign lead funnel, advanced conversion tracking (Pixel / CAPI / Google Tag Manager), ongoing daily optimization and detailed reporting

qualification_questions: Aapka target location ya audience kya hai (local city ya pan-India)?
Kya aapne pehle kabhi Facebook, Instagram ya Google par ads run kiye hain?
Aapka primary goal kya hai — direct phone calls, WhatsApp messages ya lead form submissions?

already_run_ads.angle: Audit, lower CPL & higher lead quality
already_run_ads.guidance: Politely ask how the previous campaign performed and if lead quality/cost-per-lead can be optimized through better targeting.

price_too_high.angle: Clarify service fee vs ad spend & starter pilot
price_too_high.guidance: Clarify that our service management fee starts at ₹5,000 for full campaign setup and optimization, and offer a starter test campaign.

not_needed_now.guidance: Keep relationship warm; advise them to reach out whenever they want to scale customer acquisition.

send_details.guidance: Explain simply how Meta/Google targeting works for their specific category and what results they can expect.

proposal_template.timeline: Campaign goes live within 2 to 3 days
proposal_template.process: Strategy → Setup → Launch → Daily Optimization → Reporting
